value.rationale: The newly introduced acyclic polynomial measures the full disagreement-rank distribution in acyclic orientation flip graphs. This result computes every rank coefficient for a naturally occurring nontrivial tripartite infinite family from five fixed polynomial bases, refining general unweighted complete-multipartite enumeration and a signed parity program. The exact parameterized polynomial supports parity, symmetry and distributional comparisons; its value does not rely on claiming prior signed or unsigned specializations as new.
